text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — post-launch hotlist is filling up. We have 3 items with customer impact: 1) Acme streaming regression (high), 2) onboarding UX tweak from Beta group (medium), 3) embed mismatch for a single enterprise tenant (low but annoying). We need to decide what goes into the next micro-release (2-week cadence) vs backlog. Thoughts?
Dan Chen: Do we have metrics for the Acme regression? is it affecting 1 customer or many?
Vishal Rao: Acme regression shows up at long prompt p99 for streaming (requests with >1k tokens). Affects ~8% of calls for that customer, p99 latency jumped from ~800ms -> ~2s. Repro steps in logs.
Liz Gomez: +1 patch Acme asap. If it's a streaming regression we should treat as high-priority. Can we get a targeted fix without destabilizing other customers?
Srini Iyer: I can take ownership of the patch. Plan: reproduce locally, isolate the KV cache edge-case that looks suspect, create a cherry-pick to stable branch and run the canary. Need QE to run the regression suite and a smoke on dedicated pool.
oncall-bot: Pipeline note: staging tests green, main pipeline had a transient GPU driver flake 12:03UTC (auto-retry queued).
Maya Patel: Good. Two quick asks: a) estimate for SR (Acme) fix (timebox), b) do we want to include the Beta UX tweak in same micro-release or defer?
Srini Iyer: Estimate: 1.5d to diagnose + fix + tests, 0.5d for review/merge, 0.5d for canary + verify = ~2.5-3d total. If QE prioritizes smoke, we can target next-week micro-release.
Dan Chen: For the Beta UX tweak, can the change be behind a feature flag? If so, low risk to include; otherwise defer.
Liz Gomez: It can be behind a flag, but product needs to confirm. Beta PM says they'd like it in the next release to unblock onboarding test.
Vishal Rao: Concern: including the UX tweak increases surface area for rollback if the Acme patch affects streaming infra. My preference: stage the Acme patch first, then gate the UX flag rollout after we confirm no regressions.
Maya Patel: Sounds right. Action items: 1) Srini owns Acme patch (target PR by EOD tomorrow), 2) QE (Liz please coordinate) gets regression/streaming smoke on dedicated pool, 3) Dan to prepare rollback plan + quick health dashboard for canary, 4) Beta PM to flip feature flag to "off" in prod until post-canary.
Liz Gomez: I'll set up the QE checklist and schedule the duration for canary monitoring (recommended 6 hours with token-level tracing on).
Dan Chen: Rollback plan: if p99 latency >1.5s or error rate >0.5% for 15m we rollback. I'll create the dashboard tile and a PagerDuty runbook snippet.
Maya Patel: Customer comms: if we deploy the Acme fix, let's update Acme's CSM with a short note and expected window. Srini, please add the changelog and note the commit sha.
Srini Iyer: Will do. PR will include the cherry-pick and a brief explanation. Example cherry-pick command I plan to use:```git checkout stable
git cherry-pick -x abcdef1234
```
Maya Patel: Final Q: do we bump micro-release scope to include the Beta UX behind flag? Decision: conditional — include only if QA passes the canary within 8 hours. Otherwise ship Acme-only and queue the UX for next slot.
Liz Gomez: Agreed. I'll block the QA window and report back in this thread with timestamps. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — updating the release board (assigning Srini, Liz, Dan). I'll ping the Beta PM to confirm flag gating.
Dan Chen: :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall rotation starts tomorrow at 09:00 UTC for srini.
